tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The bidder should upload the self-attested copies of CV / degree certificates/ consent letter for key professionals

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed (not less than 90 percent of contract value) as a prime contractor, at least one similar work such as Consultancy Services for Survey & Investigation, Preparation of Designs, Drawings, Estimates & DTP for Lift Irrigation Scheme and Pipe Network for Irrigation/Tank filling/Drinking Water as per CWC guidelines and shall have got approved from CWC of value not less than Rs. 20.02 Lakhs during last 5 financial years (i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26)
The intending bidder should have achieved in at least two financial years a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs. 41.00 Lakhs during the last 5 financial years reckoned back from 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Consultancy firm should have experience in consultancy services for 1 No Lift Irrigation Scheme/tank filling scheme Certificate should be obtained from an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned division
The Consultancy firm should have experience in carrying out Topographical survey using DGPS OR LiDAR OR latest equipment integrated with latest technologies
The Consultancy firm should have experience in geotechnical investigations by drilling core holes by using rigs (In AKS, SR & HR) in a single project

The approach and methodology shall clearly define the Consultant approach to complete the proposed assignment within the time frame and methodology adopted including adequacy of the proposed work plan and methodology in responding to the TOR for fair 5 marks, for good 10 marks and for best 15 marks.

1.UAV Drone equipment DGCA approved survey grade UAV certificate along with UIN number own or tie-up 1 number 4 marks, 2. Dual frequency DGPS- 3 number 4 marks, 3. Total station-3 number 4 marks and 4. High end computer work station with licensed software such as Auto CAD Civil 3D-5 numbers, Irricad Software-1 number, STADD PRO-1 number- 3 marks

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: A valid copy of the registration of the Firm Company with the register of Companies
Copy of the Income Tax returns for last 5 years from 2021-22 to 2025-26 Assesment year
The bidder should upload the self-attested copies of CV / degree certificates/ consent letter for key professionals
The intending bidder should have achieved in at least two financial years a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs. 41.00 Lakhs during the last 5 financial years reckoned back from 2024-25.

The intending bidder should have prepared consultancy services for 1 No Lift Irrigation Scheme/tank filling scheme having pipe line length of 40.33 Kms during the last five years reckoned back from 2025-26 i.e work executed during 2021-22 to 2025-26 will be considered. Certificate should be obtained from an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned division

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed not less than 90 percent of contract value as a prime contractor, at least one similar work such as Consultancy Services for Survey & Investigation, Preparation of Designs, Drawings, Estimates & DTP for Lift Irrigation Scheme and Pipe Network for Irrigation or Tank filling or Drinking Water as per CWC guidelines and shall have got approved from CWC of value not less than Rs. 20.02 Lakhs during last 5 financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site before submitting their tenders.
Valid Employees Provident Fund Registration Certificate with EPF paid challan for the month previous to the month in which tender is called through e-procurement portal.

itemList.itemName: Collection of all necessary data such as preliminary report, details of MI/ZP tanks proposed for filling in Hosadurga taluk of Chitradurga district, relevant toposheets of the area, current schedule of rates, nearest GTS bench mark etc.
itemList.specifications: Preliminary data:Collection of all necessary data such as preliminary report,

itemList.itemName: Planning for tank filling scheme comprising assessment of quantity of water required for filling of all identified 28 MI/ZP tanks (50% capacity), alternative studies to lift water from Ballalasamudra/Karehalli Barrage utilising allocated water of 0.25 TMC, establishment of water availability at lifting point, identification of techno economical location of lifting points,
itemList.specifications: Preliminary data:Planning for tank filling scheme comprising assessment of quantity of water required for filling of all identified 28 MI/ZP tanks

itemList.itemName: Conducting detailed alignment survey using DGPS/Total station Instrument for feeding proposed TANKS by Pressure / gravity flow, linked through suitable dia. Pipes natural nala off-taking from existing pipe line , which is proposed to lay below the ground with required caution as per norms, after generating of 0.50m interval contours, including feasibility study of alternative routes with pros

Collection of all necessary data, assessment of storage capacity and existing condition of Tanks proposed for filling and identify the various improvements required. Preparation of preliminary report, estimates and drawings etc.

Preparation of preliminary design, estimate and drawings for Intake channel and rising main, Pressure and gravity distribution network comprising excavation of trench, supply, jointing, laying and testing of pipe, surge analysis, surge equipment and surge protection works construction of structures, thrust blocks, valves, service road etc

Preparation of preliminary design, estimate and drawings for Intake Fore bay and Jack well cum pump house and Pumping Machinery, Pump house electrical works, Electrical Substation and terminal bay, power line and other electrical substation works etc for each stage wise lift head works its appurtenant works and Delivery chambers including roads around Jack well and Electrical Sub-Station, O & M Staff and Watchman Quarters

Preparation of Detailed Project Report and Calculation of BC ratio for Tank Filling Scheme for the work of filling up of 28 nos of tanks (50% Capacity) in Hosadurga taluk of Chitradurga district by lifting water from Ballalasamudra /Karehalli Barrage utilising allocated water of 0.25 TMC based on preliminary investigations and designs as per guidelines of WRDO, relevant guidelines of VJNL

Preparation of Bid Document for implementation of the scheme comprising, Lift Head Works, Rising Main, Jack well cum pump House, Pressure and Gravity distribution network Electro Mechanical works, Delivery Chamber, and other appurtenant works for the work of filling up of 28 nos of tanks (50% Capacity) in Hosadurga taluk of Chitradurga district by lifting water from Ballalasamudra/Karehalli Barrage utilising allocated water of 0.25 TMC

Preparation and submission of village wise land acquisition proposals for lift head works comprising intake canal, jack well cum pump house, electrical sub station, dumping yard, operator quarters, rising main, delivery chambers including procuring revenue survey maps and record of rights from revenue authority

Drilling 80 mm dia hole through over-burden using casing shoe bit vertical or inclined upto 10 degrees to vertical as directed including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, water charges, reaming, collection of wash samples at suitable intervals, logging and labelling, supplying honne wood core box, fixing casing pipes ( excluding cost of casing pipes

Drilling 76 mm dia ( NX ) core hole in hard rock using diamond core bit vertical / inclined upto 10 degree to vertical as directed including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, water charges, collection of core samples, logging and labelling samples, supplying honne wood core box including cement grouting and redrilling in case of collapse of sides ( excluding cost of cement for grouting )
